upcoming.title: 18th Annual Boulevard of Wheels Custom Car Show | Sept 5th
upcoming.body:
18th Annual Boulevard of Wheels Custom Car Show

Saturday, September 5th | 9a-3p

Located at Hackers Bar & Grille - 1532 Laskin Rd. Virginia Beach, VA. 23451 (Hilltop East)

For 18 consecutive years, on Labor Day weekend, ￼the Boulevard of Wheels presented by Street Dreams Corvette Club has consistently built upon the triumph of its previous shows. Each year it’s our goal to present an event that surpasses its predecessor in excellence. Just as previous shows, this one will be consistent with our standards as far as history and tradition, but at our NEW LOCATION.

The new venue will be Hackers Bar & Grille a luxury golf-themed restaurant and sports bar located at 1532 Laskin Rd. Virginia Beach, VA. 23451 (Hilltop East).

This location provides a bigger, better, and bolder experience in every aspect, offering participants a unique never been done before car show experience in a convenient location.
This location will offer an accommodating show field, prominent aesthetics and a serene atmosphere.
Featuring a modern sports lounge with a focus on both leisure and entertainment.
Key Features:
•Hi-Def Golf Simulators
•Cigar Lounge
•Food & Drink
•Sports Viewing (65 TVs throughout)
•Games
This prime location is so nice that I have to say it twice-This prime location is so nice and it’s just minutes away from everything (The Oceanfront, VB Town Center, Lynnhaven Mall, Ocean Breeze Water Park, VB Aquarium) and much more.
We invite you to attend the show and
make it a memorable weekend. Our hosting hotel will be, the Doubletree 1900 Pavilion Dr. Virginia Beach, VA 23451. A special SDCC discounted rate will be offered. So come join us on (Labor Day Weekend) Saturday September 5, 2026 from 9am-3pm. Pre-registration fee $25 Day of show $30. There will be a Meet & Greet on Friday evening from 6pm-10pm at Hackers as well. Hope to see you there.

upcoming.body:
Richmond Porsche Meet 2026 Autocross

Saturday, September 12th | 7:30A

Located at Richmond Raceway - 600 E. Laburnam Ave. Richmond, Virginia 23222

Shenandoah Region PCA Autocross at the Richmond Raceway on the banked oval!

Come autocross at Richmond Raceway for the unique experience of running a course on the 3/4 mile 14 degree banked turns on the NASCAR track!

The course will begin on pit road and enter the track in turn 1, go all the way around the track to finish before turn 3, (one and a half laps with a few cones to keep things safe!).

Entrants will get at least five timed runs.

The day starts EARLY with the first car off at 9:00, we have to finish the last run by 5:00.

upcoming.title: Air & Auto Classic 14 | Oct 10th
upcoming.body:
Air & Auto Classic 14

Hosted by First Settlers Region Porsche Club of America

Saturday, October 10th | 10a-4p

Located Military Aviation Museum, 1341 Princess Anne Rd, Virginia Beach, VA 23457

Please join us for our annual Air & Auto Classic charity car show, on October 10th at the Military Aviation Museum in Virginia Beach. It's a great opportunity to show off your pride and joy, check out the fabulous aviation museum and its collection of vintage aircraft, and contribute to some great charitable organizations through your participation. The show is open to all years of Foreign and Domestic cars, Vintage, Street Rods, Rat Rods, Muscle Cars, Race Cars, Sports Cars, and Special Builds.  "If you're proud of it, bring it!" 

Come out and enjoy the music, vintage aircraft, camaraderie and some friendly competition. Registration for show participants (pre-registration not required for Regular or Corral parking): If you want your car or motorcycle to be judged, we ask that you arrive between 9 - 11 am. There will be trailer parking available. - Regular Registration:  $30. Includes admission to the entire museum for everyone in your car, along with an Air & Auto Classic dash plaque for the first 100 registrants. Kindly note that the event organizer reserves the right to reclass entries. - Rockstar Parking Registration:  $75.  Includes all of the above, plus a swag bag including an event shirt (total value is over $50), and parking in a special area on the flight line.  You'll also be making a larger donation to charity!  Rockstar registration is extremely limited (only 40 spots) and can only be done online via this website. - Non-Judged Corral Parking: $20.  Non-judged parking adjacent to the flight line. 

There is no pre-registration for this option, just show up and pay when you arrive.  This option includes a dash plaque (while supplies last) and admission to the museum. - Spectator attendance is $20 per person - Includes Museum entry.
